name: app-strength-coach-app-on-lilac-to-black-gradient
title: Coach app on a lilac-to-black floor with reflective gradient
whatItIs: A tilted purple phone on a glossy surface reflecting it, against a lilac to black gradient. The screen is light grey with a heading, big '01' and '06' counters, a card for a virtual coach with a pink-red 3D glove, session times, and a pale purple start button.
whatItMeans: Sleek and athletic; the reflection and gradient make the app feel like a premium product.
techniques: Place the device on a glossy floor with a mirror reflection.
Blend from lilac to black behind the device.
Show counters as huge light numerals with tiny captions.
Use a pastel gradient button as the primary action.

vocabulary.definition: A mirrored copy of an object on a shiny surface.
Very large numbers used as key indicators.
A button filled with a soft gradient.
A card presenting an AI or digital trainer.
